description: This file defines theme configuration and color palette functions for a front-end project, providing customizable color schemes and typography settings for the 'Ocean Professional' theme.

methods.name: getOceanTheme()
methods.description: Returns base theme tokens including colors, typography, radii, and elevation settings for the Ocean Professional theme.

methods.name: getCategoricalPalette(count)
methods.description: Generates a deterministic palette of distinct colors for categorical series, based on the Ocean theme's primary and secondary colors. Ensures contrast for up to 'count' categories.

methods.name: getCategoryColorMap(categories)
methods.description: Maps category names to colors from the categorical palette, maintaining stable order.
